messages:
jun: quick heads-up — detected large ECC corrected error spike on gpunode-rack3-17 (eu-west-1). GPU driver logged ~12k corrected errors over ~3h, then node kernel panic.
raj: ouch. pod crashes? serving impact?
jun: a few model-server pods OOM-killed, kubelet restarted. I'm starting a drain now for safety.
ops-bot: automatic alert: GPU-ECC-SPIKE on gpunode-rack3-17 -> severity: medium; suggested action: drain node and open hw-rma ticket :bell:
jun: running drain command to evict non-critical pods and preserve stateful-serving pods where possible.
jun: command:
```
kubectl drain gpunode-rack3-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='!critical=true' --grace-period=60
```
elaine: what's the capacity hit for eu-west? any dedicated customer routes on that rack?
jun: rack3-17 is in the small inference pool (pool-eu-west-small). Estimated capacity loss ~9% of that pool; we have dedicated nodes in pool-eu-west-enterprise but none on that exact rack. Canary traffic will shift automatically per routing config.
sasha: can we failover cross-region for heavy traffic? cost spike but better than latency SLO misses.
sam: we can shift canaries to eu-central as temporary. Churn cost estimate ~+$120/hr while autoscaled. Do we want to do that now or wait until drain completes?
raj: prefer wait 15m to see drain progress. If pods still pending, flip canaries.
jun: drain in progress — most non-critical pods evicted, two stateful replicas still terminating (waiting for PV detach). I set node to cordon already.
jun: logs excerpt:
```
[GPU-ERR] gpu0: ecc_corrected 12034, kernel: GPU H/W recovered, but stability degrading
kernel: panic: GPU driver fault, stack trace...
```
elaine: thanks. Sam, please prepare routing change doc and cost note if we need cross-region.
sam: on it. creating an ops ticket for potential cross-region shift and budget approval.
sam: ticket created: OPS-1849 (xref INC-5421). linking to this thread.
hw-rma-bot: RMA ticket opened: RMA-9072 for gpunode-rack3-17 -> estimated replacement ETA 36-48h (vendor expedited available).
raj: can infra oncall schedule hardware swap during low-traffic window? suggest 03:00 UTC tomorrow.
jun: swap okay with me. I'll keep the node drained and set scheduling tag.
elaine: please annotate customer-facing downtime window and trigger a brief message to support in #support if customers hit errors.
jun: will do. also enabling extra autoscale headroom in eu-west small pool: +2 nodes for next 6h to absorb the drain.
ops-bot: autoscale policy applied: pool-eu-west-small scale_add=2 duration=6h by jun
sasha: once replacement arrives, do we plan to reprovision with same kernel, or try patched driver image?
sam: vendor recommends firmware update — we'll reprovision with tested driver 525.4 and run soak tests before returning to rotation.
raj: after soak, run a small canary cohort (5% traffic) for 30m then 50% for 30m.
jun: ack. I'm copying kubectl drain + logs to INC-5421 and tagging hardware team. Keeping node offline until RMA completes and image patched.
elaine: summary for execs: node experienced ECC corrected error spike -> kernel panic -> node drained -> RMA opened; capacity impact contained via autoscale and routing; hardware replace ETA 36-48h; cross-region fallback ready if needed. :white_check_mark:
sam: I'll update OPS-1849 with cost bump and notify finance for temporary spend approval.
jun: closing loop here — will post another update when RMA scheduled slot confirmed.
ops-bot: note: next status update in 2h or on state change. :timer_clock:
hw-rma-bot: vendor responded: earliest swap slot available in 34h, technician ETA confirmed.
jun: thx — marking this thread monitored. :eyes:
